lines.text: If you find your brother's lost animal or belongings, you must return them, and you must help lift a fallen donkey or ox.
You must let the mother bird go and take only the young, and you must build a railing around your new roof.
When a husband falsely accuses his wife, her parents bring proof to the elders, who fine him two hundred shekels of silver.
In the open country, only the man who overpowers a betrothed woman must die, because she cried out but no one saved her.
A man who seizes an unpledged virgin must pay her father fifty shekels, and a man must not marry his uncle's wife.
